Name: The Old Bakehouse. Style: Sourdough, soups and cream teas. Town: Kirkhill, 2 Market Steps (example), Kirkhill.
Hours: Sunday: 9am till 2pm. Tuesday to Saturday: 9am till 5pm. Closed Mondays.
Tables for 6 or more can be booked, and afternoon tea; smaller tables are walk-in.
Afternoon tea, £22.00 a person, booked 2 days ahead, sittings at 1pm and 3pm. Gluten-free with 3 days' notice.

Menu: Espresso, Americano, Flat white, Cappuccino, Latte, Pot of tea, Hot chocolate, Full breakfast, Veggie breakfast, Avocado on sourdough, Bacon sandwich, Porridge, Soup of the day with bread, Ham and cheese toastie, Cheese and onion toastie, Tuna melt, Jacket potato, Salad bowl, Victoria sponge, Carrot cake.

Dogs: outside only. Children: Children are very welcome: there’s a children’s menu and babyccinos. Access: Step-free from the street, with an accessible toilet. Wi-Fi: Free Wi-Fi; the password is on the counter. Laptops: Laptops are welcome, except at weekend lunchtimes when we need the tables. Parking: No parking of our own; the nearest car park is about five minutes’ walk.

Cash: card only. Tips go in the jar, shared by everyone. Cups: Bring your own cup and we’ll happily fill it. Hire: The café can be hired in the evenings for parties: the owner will call back to talk it through. Jobs: We sometimes have weekend roles: leave your name and number and the owner will be in touch.
